Title: Package Migration to Secondary Overlay
Author: Jane Doe <jane@example.com>
Posted: 2026-08-13
Revision: 1
News-Item-Format: 2.0
Display-If-Installed: dev-util/example-bin

The `dev-util/example-bin` package has been removed from this overlay
because `dev-util/example-tool` is now available in the target overlay.

Please migrate your installation:

emerge --deselect dev-util/example-bin
emerge --ask dev-util/example-tool
emerge --depclean dev-util/example-bin
